title: Gustaf Tenggren blog
content: Gustaf Tenggren (Swedish-American 1896-1970) is best known as a designer for Disney's Pinocchio and an illustrator for classic Golden Books like theTawny Scrawny Lion.Lars Emanuelsson, who runsa website on Tenggrennow has ablog. He is working on a book about Tenggren that will be released next year.Gustaf Tenggren blogThanks, Bertil Saukkoriipi
